review.notes: Independent review of issue #9796 (package PR #9834). Corrections applied in place. README: removed planning residue (258 packet slugs, about 140 process sentences, packet ids, citation shorthands, download notes) and merged seven duplicate references. Repointed every lower-tier supplier citation to an actual section (DT 0.1-0.3, 2.4, 2.8; IHG 0.5-0.6; AA 3.4, 4.2; GN 4.3 in TauCetiRoadmap PR #851). Proved the product-form Siegel step from DT 2.8 siegelRelativeKernelBasis because DT has no product-form lemma. Added targets 4.0 (Pell automorphs, correcting the false 'infinite cyclic' claim to PSL2) and 7.0 (pseudobases and Steinitz classes) for notions GN does not supply. Duplication against current TauCetiRoadmap and Tau Ceti a91d3aaf: removed old 1.21 (isPrimitive_fundamentalDiscriminantChar), reduced 1.7 to an API variant on fundamentalDiscriminantChar, and noted one-clause differences in 5.21, 5.23, 5.24 and 7.2. Replaced 48 Layer 7 Checks that restated their theorem with 123 hand-computed checks; all 136 definition blocks have three or more Checks. Sources: checked every flagged locator and a sample of 15; corrected Chinburg-Pappas-Taylor (3.1)-(3.2), Theorem 5.4 paraphrase, Theorem 6.2 pages and the Wall citation, Froehlich 1976 (2.11)-(2.19), and the 6.77 claim that Bary-Soroker-Koukoulopoulos-Kozma misprinted L(m) (their form holds by Louboutin's constant). Proofs not in any open source stay explicitly marked (Mignotte 1988, Rosser-Schoenfeld Cor. 3, Smyth 1971, Dobrowolski 1979, Ward's singular primes, the 1+i supplement, Froehlich-Taylor 1980, Wall, Froehlich/Reiner book inputs).
